# Original failed Launcher filesystem installation fragment.
# Service activation deliberately excluded; tests mock only Root ownership/path boundary.
def install(manifest):
    rows = manifest['replacements']
    assert len(rows) == 8 and sum((row['current_sha256'] != row['new_sha256'] or row.get('repair_mode', False) for row in rows)) == 4, 'FIXED_INSTALLATION_WRITE_SCOPE'
    unchanged = []
    backup = Path(manifest['backup_directory'])
    backup.mkdir(parents=True, mode=448, exist_ok=False)
    changes = []
    for index, row in enumerate(manifest['replacements'], 1):
        target = Path(row['target'])
        if row.get('create_fixed_parent'):
            assert str(target) == '/etc/systemd/system/soc-continuous-dns.service.d/trial-deadline.conf'
            for ancestor in target.parent.parents:
                info = ancestor.lstat()
                assert info.st_uid == 0 and (not info.st_mode & 18) and (not stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode)), 'UNTRUSTED_FIXED_DNS_PARENT'
            target.parent.mkdir(mode=493, exist_ok=False)
        for parent in target.parents:
            info = parent.lstat()
            assert info.st_uid == 0 and (not info.st_mode & 18) and (not stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode)), 'UNTRUSTED_TARGET_PARENT'
        if row.get('current_state') == 'ABSENT':
            assert not target.exists() and (not target.is_symlink())
            saved = None
        else:
            info = target.lstat()
            assert info.st_uid == 0 and (not info.st_mode & 18) and stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
            assert sha(target) == row['current_sha256']
            saved = backup / (str(index) + '-' + target.name)
            fd = os.open(saved, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 384)
            with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
                stream.write(target.read_bytes())
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            assert sha(saved) == row['current_sha256']
        body = Path(row['new_source']).read_bytes()
        assert hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == row['new_sha256']
        if row['current_sha256'] == row['new_sha256'] and (not row.get('repair_mode', False)):
            assert sha(target) == row['new_sha256']
            verified = dict(target=str(target), backup=str(saved), new_sha256=row['new_sha256'], operation='VERIFIED_UNCHANGED_NO_REPLACEMENT')
            unchanged.append(verified)
            evidence('installed-' + str(index) + '.json', verified)
            continue
        temporary = target.with_name('.' + target.name + '.one-hour-fixed')
        fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 420)
        os.fchmod(fd, 420)
        assert stat.S_IMODE(os.fstat(fd).st_mode) == 420, 'FIXED_INSTALLATION_PERMISSION'
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
            stream.write(body)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        if row.get('current_state') == 'ABSENT':
            os.link(temporary, target)
            temporary.unlink()
        else:
            assert sha(target) == row['current_sha256']
            os.replace(temporary, target)
        assert sha(target) == row['new_sha256']
        assert target.stat().st_uid == 0 and stat.S_IMODE(target.stat().st_mode) == 420, 'FIXED_TARGET_MODE'
        dirfd = os.open(target.parent, os.O_DIRECTORY)
        try:
            os.fsync(dirfd)
        finally:
            os.close(dirfd)
        changes.append(dict(target=str(target), backup=str(saved) if saved else 'PREVIOUSLY_ABSENT', new_sha256=row['new_sha256']))
        evidence('installed-' + str(index) + '.json', changes[-1])
    evidence('installed-files.json', dict(replaced=changes, verified_unchanged=unchanged, preserved=manifest['preserve_and_verify']))
